native_mechanisms: A single rolling sphere (one accumulator) is the sole carried memory across the whole ordered pile.
Each mark is pressed in, then a fixed count of tumbles down the mason trail mixes it, with the crack angle read off the sphere becoming the next carried rotation.
Only the final hairline crack in the last stalk is handed over; the sphere, intermediate cracks and dust are swept away.
core_technique: Single 64-bit accumulator hash: xor each 8-byte word, then a fixed two ARX rounds of add-constant, xorshift, and RC5-style data-dependent rotation by the accumulator's own low bits (no multiplication), with a length seed, overlapping tail read, and a xor-rotate-add finalizer.
